name: factory-forge
description: Deterministically generate a quarantined factory scaffold inside a factory_run directory for manual review only.

stages.name: map-forge-request
stages.expectedOutcome: Extract deterministic scaffold requirements from one factory-forge input item.
stages.promptTemplate: Read factory-forge item {item.id} at {item.path}. Identify the requested generated factory name and quarantine-only constraints. Return explore.v1 with evidence and risks.
mustDo: Read the input item before conclusions.
Confirm generated output must stay under {run.dir}/quarantine/.
mustNotDo: No edits outside the run directory.
stages.context: Factory {factory.name} run {run.id}; map stage for quarantined scaffold request {item.id}.

stages.name: reduce-quarantine-scaffold
stages.expectedOutcome: Synthesize the deterministic quarantined scaffold plan without activation.
stages.promptTemplate: Synthesize factory-forge outputs for run {run.id}. Confirm scaffold stays under {run.dir}/quarantine/ and is not registered under .pi/factories. Return explicit synthesis.v1 sections/headings: consensus, conflicts, missing_evidence, recommended_next_action, tasks_to_rerun, evidence, risks/blockers, compliance, and deliverable_delivered.
mustDo: Include the exact words consensus, conflicts, missing_evidence, recommended_next_action, and tasks_to_rerun.

stages.name: validate-quarantine-only
stages.expectedOutcome: Validate quarantine metadata, no auto-activation, and DONE.sentinel only after validation.
stages.promptTemplate: Validate factory-forge run {run.id} before the parent final gate writes phase/DONE sentinels. Check validation.json and quarantine scaffold under {run.dir}/quarantine/; treat final phase/DONE sentinels as pending unless the parent final gate has already written them. Fail if generated factory is registered under .pi/factories or autoActivation is true. Return explicit oracle-merge.v1 sections/headings: verdict, confidence, no_ship, blocking_issues, merged_lanes, evidence, risks/blockers, compliance, and deliverable_delivered.
mustDo: Verify quarantine path is inside the run directory.
Do not fail merely because final phase/DONE sentinels are pending before the parent final gate.
Include the exact words verdict, confidence, no_ship, blocking_issues, and merged_lanes.
